name: gen-ui-demo
description: Two-stage Claude tool-use pipeline that composes UI from a small web-component library, without generating any code.

scripts.dev:functions: npm run build && wrangler pages dev dist --port 8788 --compatibility-date=2026-05-22 --compatibility-flag=nodejs_compat
scripts.shoelace:assets: rm -rf public/shoelace && mkdir -p public/shoelace && cp -r node_modules/@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/assets public/shoelace/
